stem.text: Which statement correctly identifies the movement of sucrose and amino acids in plant vascular tissue?

A.text: They are carried from source to sink by mass flow in upward and downward directions.

B.text: They are carried from sink to source by cohesion-tension in upward and downward directions.

C.text: They are carried from sink to source by mass flow in one direction.

D.text: They are carried from source to sink by cohesion-tension in one direction.
